description: Configurable cam ship merge mode (immediate | ci-gated): init/config sets+tests+warns branch protection; ci-gated hands off after auto-merge and the sidecar runs the autonomous post-merge.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: required_status_checks.contexts (array of strings) is DEPRECATED in favor of checks (array of {context, app_id?}); both still work, so the helper PUTs checks:[{context:"ci"}] and the GET verification accepts the check under either checks or contexts. In the PUT body all four top-level fields are REQUIRED and must be present (use null to disable): required_status_checks, enforce_admins, required_pull_request_reviews (use null), restrictions (use null). Accept header application/vnd.github+json. Requires admin access; the fallback path triggers on 403/no-admin.

The accessor returns "immediate" when the file is missing, the [ship] section is absent, the key is absent, the TOML is malformed, or the value is any string other than "ci-gated" (defensive default, mirroring readPhaseModel). [oracle: bun test]
The accessor returns "ci-gated" only when the [ship] merge_mode value is exactly the string "ci-gated". [oracle: bun test]

userStories.title: Branch-protection helper module (gh api PUT/GET, configure + verify + verify-and-warn fallback)
userStories.description: As cam init/config, I need a deterministic, injectable helper that configures branch protection on main requiring the 'ci' check, verifies it applied, and degrades to a verify+warn hint when the gh api call fails (no admin / no auth), so ci-gated mode can be set up without manual GitHub clicks but never hard-fails the wizard.
acceptanceCriteria: The helper exposes a pure function taking an injectable synchronous SpawnFn (mirroring src/commands/ship-finalize.ts: DI'd spawnSync, NOT Bun.spawn) and returns a structured result discriminating configured-and-verified vs fallback-warned vs error. [oracle: bun test]

On configure, it invokes `gh api -X PUT repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/main/protection` with a body that includes ALL FOUR required top-level fields: required_status_checks (object with strict:true and checks:[{context:"ci"}]), enforce_admins:false, required_pull_request_reviews:null, restrictions:null. [oracle: bun test]
The PUT request sets the Accept header to application/vnd.github+json. [oracle: bun test]

After the PUT it issues a GET on the same protection endpoint and treats the configuration as verified only when the 'ci' check appears under either the `checks` array or the deprecated `contexts` array in the response. [oracle: bun test]

When the gh api call returns a non-zero exit or a 403 / no-admin / no-auth error, the helper degrades to the verify+warn path: it returns a fallback-warned result carrying a hint string telling the operator how to enable branch protection manually, and does NOT throw. [oracle: bun test]
The helper also checks the CAM-84 prerequisites (Allow auto-merge + Allow squash merging enabled on the repo) and surfaces a hint when either is off, without hard-failing. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: NEW module: suggest src/release/branch-protection.ts (sits with src/release/ship-bump.ts, tag logic). MIRROR src/commands/ship-finalize.ts and src/commands/issue-file.ts: DI'd synchronous SpawnFn, hermetic gh/git tests, exported result interface, never Bun.spawn. DOC DEPRECATION (note in code header): required_status_checks.contexts is deprecated in favor of checks:[{context}]; PUT checks, accept either checks or contexts in the GET verification (GitHub mirrors them). All four PUT top-level fields REQUIRED — omitting any is a 422. enforce_admins=false (operator decision 3: emergency force-merge), required_pull_request_reviews=null (gotcha 3: a non-null reviews block would block auto-merge forever without a human review), strict=true (operator decision 3). The 'ci' string is the exact required check name (gotcha 1). Fallback hint must parallel AUTOMERGE_NOTICE in src/logging/notices.ts. Reuse printHint/printWarning from src/logging/color.ts for operator-facing output; keep the gh-api logic pure/returning a result so it is headlessly testable.

userStories.title: cam-ship.md ci-gated branching: hand off after auto-merge, skip inline post-merge
userStories.description: As the orchestrator executing /cam-ship, I need the ci-gated path to end after `gh pr create` + `gh pr merge --auto --squash` and explicitly hand the post-merge (pull/tag/prune) to the sidecar, while the immediate path stays unchanged, so the orchestrator never assumes an immediate merge under ci-gated.
acceptanceCriteria: Both copies of the command (templates/commands/cam-ship.md and .claude/commands/cam-ship.md) document that, when [ship] merge_mode is ci-gated, ship ends after `gh pr create` + `gh pr merge --auto --squash` and does NOT run the inline pull/tag/prune (the sidecar completes it autonomously). [oracle: grep -q 'ci-gated' templates/commands/cam-ship.md]

Both copies document that, when merge_mode is immediate, the existing behavior is unchanged (the orchestrator does the post-merge by hand as today). [oracle: grep -q 'ci-gated' .claude/commands/cam-ship.md]

The vendor codegen is re-run so src/vendor/_generated.ts templatesContents["commands/cam-ship.md"] matches the edited templates/commands/cam-ship.md byte-for-byte. [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
An oracle test asserts the embedded templatesContents["commands/cam-ship.md"] string contains the ci-gated branching language. [oracle: bun test]
Vendor drift check passes (bun run embed-vendor:check). [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Files: templates/commands/cam-ship.md (canonical source the codegen reads) + .claude/commands/cam-ship.md (the project-local installed copy) MUST both be edited, then run `bun run embed-vendor` and confirm `bun run embed-vendor:check` passes. The codegen reads templates/ (NOT .claude/); the embedded const key is templatesContents["commands/cam-ship.md"] in src/vendor/_generated.ts. Today cam-ship.md has NO inline post-merge (Step 7 ends at gh pr create + best-effort gh pr merge --auto --squash; the orchestrator does pull/tag/journal/prune by hand) — the ci-gated branch makes the handoff explicit and states the sidecar finishes it. Step 3 check:all (local gate + CI gate, belt-and-suspenders) stays in BOTH modes (do NOT remove). cam ship --bump and --finalize still run on the BRANCH before push in both modes; only the tag is post-merge-only. DRIFT WARNING: the two cam-ship.md copies are ALREADY out of sync on main (templates/commands/cam-ship.md ~4928 bytes vs .claude/commands/cam-ship.md ~4605 bytes); embed-vendor:check only validates templates/ against _generated.ts (NEVER .claude/), so apply the SAME edit to BOTH copies and do not treat either as authoritative. The pre-existing 323-byte drift is a separate latent issue, out of scope for this story.

userStories.title: Deterministic post-merge invocable (pull origin main + tag-on-main + prune local/remote)
userStories.description: As the sidecar, I need a deterministic, injectable post-merge primitive that pulls origin main, tags vX.Y.Z reading version.ts from main, and prunes the merged branch locally and on the remote, so the autonomous post-merge runs without operator intervention and never writes the journal.
acceptanceCriteria: A new exported function (e.g. runPostMerge) takes an injectable synchronous SpawnFn (mirroring ship-finalize.ts) and performs, in order: git pull origin main, create+push the vX.Y.Z tag, delete the merged branch locally and on origin. [oracle: bun test]

The tag step reads the version from src/version.ts on main AFTER the pull (NOT the installed binary's embedded literal), so a stale installed binary cannot mis-tag (stale-binary class). [oracle: bun test]
The tag step is idempotent: when the vX.Y.Z tag already exists it is a no-op (exit clean), reusing the cam tag logic / guards. [oracle: bun test]
The function does NOT write or append the journal (the orchestrator owns journal authorship; the post-merge is pure deterministic git). [oracle: ! grep -iq 'journal' src/release/post-merge.ts]
The function returns a structured result describing what it did (pulled sha, tag created-or-existed, branch pruned local/remote) for the sidecar to narrate. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: NEW module: suggest src/release/post-merge.ts. MIRROR ship-finalize.ts (DI'd spawnSync, hermetic tests). REUSE/extract the tag logic from src/commands/tag.ts (runTag tags main HEAD from CAM_VERSION; here the version must be read from src/version.ts on main AFTER `git pull origin main`, not from the running binary — gotcha 4 + scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md "Release Conventions": always tag on main after pull, never the branch SHA). DECISION 2: NO journal write — the post-merge is pull+tag+prune ONLY; the orchestrator stays the sole journal author, triggered by the sidecar's narration. Invoked BY the sidecar (US-007), never inline in ship. Per scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md the 0.x convention + 1.0.0 escape hatch live in computeNextVersion — do not duplicate; just read the literal version on main. Note for the [oracle: ! grep -iq 'journal'] check: the assertion is case-insensitive, so ensure the module file contains no 'journal' token in ANY casing (no appendJournalEntry, JournalWriter, etc.); narrate to the orchestrator and let it author the journal.

userStories.title: Sidecar merge-watch state: poll PR for MERGED then run post-merge + narrate
userStories.description: As the operator, I need the sidecar (under ci-gated) to watch the open PR, run the deterministic post-merge and narrate success when GitHub lands the merge, and narrate-and-stop when CI is red or the PR is closed-not-merged, so the post-merge completes autonomously and the orchestrator is always told the outcome.
acceptanceCriteria: The sidecar gains a merge-watch path that polls `gh pr view <N> --json state,mergeStateStatus` and, on state==MERGED, runs the US-006 post-merge invocable, then narrates the result to the orchestrator via the existing notifyOrchestrator (send-keys) seam. [oracle: bun test]

On a CI-red / closed-not-merged poll result the sidecar narrates a clear 'CI red, PR #N open, not merged' (or closed-not-merged) line and STOPS the merge-watch without running the post-merge. [oracle: bun test]
Merge-watch only engages under ci-gated merge mode; under immediate it is inert (zero behavior change). [oracle: bun test]

The merge-watch is wired through src/supervisor/loop.ts and src/commands/sidecar.ts with all I/O injectable, and an integration test drives the MERGED -> post-merge -> narrate path and the CI-red -> narrate+stop path with fakes. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/loop.ts (the sidecar/supervisor terminal states today are complete|awaiting-operator|blocked|max-iterations; add the merge-watch as a new state/path, reusing the notifyOrchestrator(line) send-keys seam from CAM-70/78 — do NOT invent a new narration channel, single-pusher invariant CAM-78) + src/commands/sidecar.ts (runSidecar polls the active flag; thread the merge-watch with injectable gh-poll + post-merge fns). GOTCHA 2: ci-gated introduces ASYNCHRONY — the orchestrator must NOT assume immediate merge; the sidecar (survives between orchestrator turns) owns the wait. Poll `gh pr view <N> --json state,mergeStateStatus`; MERGED -> run US-006 + narrate; CI-red/closed-not-merged -> narrate + stop (operator fixes, new push re-runs CI, merge lands, sidecar completes). Reuse the PR number source the ship path already knows. Keep injectable SpawnFn / poll fn so the integration test is hermetic (fakes lie about tmux — see lessons; prefer a tmux-introspect-style check where feasible, but unit-level fakes are fine for the gh-poll state machine).

userStories.title: ci-gated end-to-end dogfood on a real PR (operator)
userStories.description: As the operator, I need to confirm on a real PR that ci-gated branch protection is applied, the CI gates the merge, and the autonomous post-merge runs and narrates, so the feature is proven against real GitHub and not just hermetic fakes.
acceptanceCriteria: On a real ci-gated project, branch protection is applied to main requiring the 'ci' check (confirmed via gh api GET protection showing 'ci' under checks or contexts). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
A real PR with a green CI auto-merges only after the 'ci' Actions check passes (GitHub gates the merge; it does NOT merge immediately). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

After GitHub lands the merge, the sidecar runs the autonomous post-merge (pull origin main + vX.Y.Z tag at main HEAD + branch prune local+remote) and narrates the result to the orchestrator. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

userStories.notes: OPERATOR-ONLY (requires real GitHub repo admin, a real Actions run, real network + merge). The implementer cannot satisfy this headlessly and must exit BLOCKED_OPERATOR_REQUIRED so the loop falls through. Validates US-002 (protection applied + verified), US-005 (ship hands off under ci-gated), US-006/US-007 (sidecar post-merge + narration), and the CI-red red path. Confirm the tag reads version.ts on main post-pull (gotcha 4). enforce_admins=false means the operator can still force-merge in an emergency. See docs/recovery-runbook.md (t) for the stuck-merge recovery steps.
